method.honest_label: post-Gold paper-derived method reconstruction with a locked implementation and prospective one-shot evaluation

runtime.note: offline, no download, no network; same model family as the Winter Stage 3 development baseline

actor_derivation.single_nonempty_lane_label: actor = the unique non-empty lane label
actor_derivation.empty_lane_or_no_lane: actor = pool name via BPMN XML lane-set mapping (status pool_fallback_empty_lane)

semantic_content_derivation.verb_style_action: action = root VERB token surface; append xcomp VERB chain tokens separated by single space (verb-complement composition)
semantic_content_derivation.verb_style_object: object = dependency subtree of the object label under root/xcomp verb (obj/dobj/dative/attr): includes determiners, adjectives, noun modifiers and conj branches; excludes aux/auxpass/punct tokens and the preposition token itself; prep objects (pobj) inside the object subtree are merged with the preposition token excluded; prep phrases attached directly to the verb are treated as adjuncts and excluded
semantic_content_derivation.passive_object: object = passive subject (nsubjpass/csubjpass) subtree when present
semantic_content_derivation.noun_style_object: object = concatenation (single space) of prep pobj subtrees attached to the action noun, preposition tokens excluded; empty when no prep
semantic_content_derivation.conjunction_inclusion: conj branches of the head object token are included in the subtree
semantic_content_derivation.action_only: object = null with verb_style_action_only / noun_style_action_only status when the object derivation is empty
semantic_content_derivation.degenerate: all surfaces null with degenerate_label status
semantic_content_derivation.empty: all surfaces null with empty_label status

claim_boundary: P2 is a Sun/Leopold-style method-level independent reconstruction locked AFTER the Stage 1 Process Gold was formed: locked implementation, locked config, locked offline runtime; one-shot prospective formal evaluation without any post-evaluation tuning. It is not exact reproduction, not the Sun original implementation, and not a P1 enhancement.
